title: ChickenLayingRework
description: Chickens no longer drop eggs automatically. When ready to lay, right-click the chicken to collect the egg.
body:
## Chicken Laying Rework

Chicken Laying Rework changes how chickens produce eggs.

Instead of automatically dropping eggs on the ground, chickens now become **ready to lay**, and the player must **right-click the chicken with an empty hand** to collect the egg.

This makes egg collection more interactive while keeping the mechanic simple and vanilla-friendly.

---

### Features

- Chickens no longer drop eggs automatically
- Chickens visually change when they are ready to lay
- Right-click a ready chicken to collect the egg
- Egg timer resets after collection
- No new items, blocks, or complex mechanics

---

### Why?

Vanilla chickens randomly drop eggs on the ground, which often leads to eggs being lost, despawning, or scattered around farms.

This mod turns egg production into a simple interaction, making farms cleaner and more intentional while still feeling like vanilla gameplay.

---

### Compatibility

This mod only changes chicken egg-laying behavior and should be compatible with most mods.

Mods that heavily modify chicken AI or rendering may conflict.
